rootCause.probeArtifact: Round-1 m50/m68 URL scenarios never set the event magnitude/depth: applyUrlParams writes magSlider.value/depthSlider.value without dispatching input events, so _liveMag/_liveDepth kept the page defaults (M7.0 / 30 km) and startSimulation ran THOSE. The round-1 "m50 +1.4 hot" and "m68 -0.2" blocks above both measured the same default M7.0/30 event at two locations (their FINALs 6.4 vs 6.5 agree). Round-2 probe drives the sliders with real input events and refuses to run when _liveMag disagrees with the scenario (see actual event readouts per scenario).
rootCause.m50-crustal: With the event actually M5.0/12 the inversion is unbiased: FINAL 5.0-5.1 (bias 0.0/+0.1), decomp medExcessVsTrueGMPE ~0.97, freezeResidual 1.0. No small-event mechanism existed; nothing to fix. The persistent b2 mid-run dip (~-1.4) is an early-transient: at trCount>=10 the distance window switches 3-500km -> 30-200km, discarding the correctly-reading near stations while the 30-200km stations are still mid P-S ramp; it self-corrects by b4. Left as-is (out of steady-state scope).
rootCause.m68-m73: True residual was -0.6 (round-1 "fine" was the same probe artifact). Diag decomp: medFreezeResidual 0.41-0.44 — FINAL convergence (>=25 s, stable 10 s window) fires while the median 30-200km-window station is still mid P-S ramp, so the ramp-floor nowcast (schedPeak * rampF, rampF~0.41) feeds ~0.4x peak to the inversion: log10(0.41)/0.5 ~= -0.78 M. Fix A gates the median to ramp-complete stations (rampF >= 1, floor = full scheduled peak) once >= 5 exist; early bulletins keep the full nowcast set. FINAL: m68 6.2 -> 6.8, m73 6.7 -> 7.4.
rootCause.tohoku-m91: Near-field PGA saturates (Zhao 3200 gal soft cap + gmpeSatMag): per-station inversions pin at ~7.2-7.9 and the trimmed median follows. The legacy spread lift (spread > 1.0, n >= 20) was BISTABLE: round-1 FINALs read 7.4 (never fired); the round-2 pre-fix diag run fired exactly once at the FINAL solve (spread 0.80 -> 1.04) and read 8.6. Post fix-A the ramp-complete distribution tightens (med 7.87, top 8.27, spread 0.40, n = 8) so the legacy gate can never fire; fix B adds the plateau rule (med > 7.6 and spread > 0.2, n >= 5, lift min(top, med+0.5)) which is the post-gate form of the same saturation signature. FINAL 8.4, inside the 7.9-8.5 JMA-parity band (JMA operational read for this event: 7.9).

fixes.fixA_rampGate: public/app.js _detectSolveTrack: per-station rampDone = (rampF >= 1); inversion median uses magValsDone (ramp-complete stations) when >= 5 available, else the full set. No constants.
fixes.fixB_giantLift: SimUtils.eewGiantEventLift(medM, topM, nVals) in public/sim-utils.js. Plateau rule: EEW_MAG_GIANT_MED_GATE 7.6, EEW_MAG_GIANT_SPREAD_GATE 0.2, EEW_MAG_GIANT_LIFT_CAP 0.5, n >= 5. Legacy wide-spread rule preserved: EEW_MAG_SPREAD_MIN_STATIONS 20, EEW_MAG_SPREAD_LEGACY 1.0, EEW_MAG_SPREAD_LEGACY_CAP 1.5. Lift always clamped to [medM, topM].
fixes.m65-75_guard: M6.8 FINAL 6.8 (was 6.2 true-residual; round-1-published 6.5), M7.3 FINAL 7.4 (was 6.7): both moved by fix A only (the ramp drag), not by the plateau lift (med gate 7.6 closed; even a gate flap clamps at top-med ~0.15 <= 0.2).
